generator: reference tools of the Holiday Lights 5.4 analysis (not part of this repository; see Golden/README.md)
source: the 47 .mid files of the Holiday Lights 5.4 distribution: content/Music (46 songs) and tests/HolidayLights.Tests/Fixtures/Music/reset.mid

conventions.order: files sorted by name (ordinal); includes the hidden reset.mid
conventions.trackCount: number of MTrk chunks parsed (trackCountHeader = MThd ntrks)
conventions.division: raw MThd division (ticks per quarter note when bit 15 is clear)
conventions.counts: per track: noteOn = 9n with velocity > 0; noteOff = 8n plus 9n with velocity 0; controlChange = Bn; programChange = Cn; pitchBend = En; polyPressure = An; channelPressure = Dn; sysex = F0 and F7 events; meta = FF events by type (hex key, End of Track 0x2F included); running status honoured
conventions.lastTick: absolute tick of the last event of the track (its End of Track); song lastTick = max
conventions.tempoChanges: every Set Tempo (FF 51) of every track in playback order (tick, then track)
conventions.duration: PPQN: 500000 us per quarter until the first Set Tempo; tickTempoSum = sum over tempo segments up to the song lastTick of ticks * usPerQuarter; exact duration = tickTempoSum / division us; durationMicroseconds = floor(tickTempoSum / division)
conventions.lastEvent: lastEventTick = tick of the last event that is not End of Track (max over tracks); lastEventMicroseconds = same formula up to that tick.  Windows' MCI sequencer reports 'status length' up to this point (it computes with whole microseconds per tick, so its value is up to ~0.07 % shorter, at most 76 ms for these files); it differs from durationMicroseconds where End of Track comes later (Bicycle Built for Two 2.07 s, Chanukah Song 4.0 s, Clementine 1.05 s, reset.mid 2.0 s)
conventions.quirks: per track: noteOnVelocity0 = note-ons with velocity 0 (counted as noteOff); runningStatusAfterMetaOrSysex = data bytes that reuse the channel status across a meta/SysEx event (SMF 1.0 says those cancel running status; the parser keeps it)
